title: dev-loops config
description: GENERATED FILE — do not edit by hand; regenerate with `node scripts/generate-config-schema.mjs`. Extracted from FileConfigSchema in packages/core/src/config/config.mjs, the validator the loader applies to every config file layer: the shipped defaults in packages/core/src/config/extension-defaults.yaml, the repo-local .pi/dev-loop/defaults.* layer, consumer .devloops (.yaml/.yml/.json), and the legacy .pi/dev-loop/settings.*/overrides.* fallbacks. The zod loader remains authoritative: cross-field refinements (models.roleTiers alias resolution, uiReview step per-action requirements, regex validity) are enforced there and cannot be expressed in JSON Schema.

conductor.description: Model override for the conductor (dev-loop) session; absent = inherit the session model.

roles.description: Concrete per-role/angle model overrides (highest precedence, above tiers).

tiers.description: Tier alias → per-harness concrete model; null on a harness means inherit (no override).

roleTiers.description: Role or gate angle → tier alias: a built-in alias (low, high), a custom models.tiers alias, or "inherit".

models.description: Model routing: conductor override, per-role overrides, tier aliases, and role→tier policy.

mode.description: Whether refinement reviewers run in parallel or one after another.

maxCopilotRounds.description: Automated Copilot review rounds before converging; 0 disables Copilot review.

lowSignal.description: Early-stop policy for low-signal Copilot rounds.

enabled.description: Stop Copilot rounds early once they stop producing signal.

roundThreshold.description: Rounds counted toward the low-signal stop decision.

maxComments.description: A round with at most this many comments counts as low-signal.

roles.description: Review lenses the refinement fan-out dispatches.

refinement.description: Refinement fan-out and Copilot review-round behavior.

angles.description: Review lenses this gate fans out to. A bare string is sugar for { name }; an object may set mandatory/enabled/persona/prompt/model/tier.

mandatory.description: Always run this angle, regardless of diff-based dynamic selection.

enabled.description: Set false to drop this angle from the resolved list (a later config layer disabling a base angle).

prompt.description: Short focused instruction for the reviewer agent — what to look for and how to judge this angle.

model.description: Concrete model override for this angle (highest precedence).

tier.description: Model tier alias for this angle (used when `model` is absent).

scope.description: Surface scope this angle needs: full (default), changed-files (diff without the adjacent-code bundle or its changed-files/adjacent-file summary section), or docs-only (doc-file hunks only). Unknown/omitted resolves to full.

dynamic.description: Diff-driven dynamic angle selection policy for this gate.

subtractive.description: Enable diff-driven dynamic angle PRUNING for this gate (ON by default; set false to restore the full static angle pool). Was gates.<gate>.dynamicAngles.

additive.description: Allow diff-driven addition of catalog angles beyond this gate's configured pool (was gates.<gate>.additiveAngles).

requireCi.description: Per-gate CI prerequisite (default true): the gate requires green CI on the current head; false opts this gate out of the CI precondition entirely, including a real failure.

blockCleanOnFindingSeverities.description: Defect finding severities that block a clean gate verdict (high/medium/low only — "question"/"nit" are non-defect categories and never block by severity). "must-fix" is the deprecated legacy spelling of "high", "worth-fixing-now" of "medium", and "nice-to-have"/"defer" of "low"; consumers normalize them.

mediumFixWindow.description: Per-gate medium fix window: an open medium finding stays in the in-gate fix loop through this many rounds of this gate's chain before deferral. high is exempt (never defers). Default 3.

worthFixingNowFixWindow.description: Deprecated alias for mediumFixWindow (pre-rename key name); mediumFixWindow wins when both are set.

name.description: Tier name; surfaces as the tier:<name> resolution reason.

kinds.description: Changed-file kinds this tier matches; every changed file's classifyFile() kind must be in this set.

maxFiles.description: Match only when the change touches at most this many files.

maxLines.description: Match only when the change stays within this many changed lines.

match.description: Diff-class conditions that select this tier.

angles.description: Angle set this tier resolves to when matched; unioned with the gate's mandatory angles.

tiers.description: Ordered, first-match-wins diff-class angle tiers for this gate. When the first-matching tier's angle set is inside the gate's angle pool, it replaces dynamic angle reduction for that diff class.

draft.description: Draft gate config (runs before a PR leaves draft).

spike.description: Relaxed spike gate profile; applies only to spike-mode work.

requireFanoutEvidence.description: Require fan-out/fan-in review evidence on gate verdicts; inline single-agent verdicts are rejected except under the strict light-mode exception (under-threshold scope, no gate:full label, recorded inline reason).

requireFanoutProvenance.description: Additionally require recorded, internally-consistent fan-out provenance (distinct reviewer count + per-angle dispatch).

maxFanoutReviewers.description: SUPERSEDED by gates.fanout.maxConcurrent (#1601, ADR 0048): no longer governs fan-out dispatch — the conductor dispatches wave-by-wave at most gates.fanout.maxConcurrent (M) dispatch units per wave via scheduleFanoutWaves (the wave plan emitted by write-gate-context.mjs). Kept for back-compat; setting it has no dispatch effect.

postFindingsComments.description: Also post consolidated gate findings as a second marker-tagged PR comment, duplicating the verdict review's own findings (default false).

anglePool.description: Explicit global lens catalog for additive angle selection (global, not per-gate).

rejectForeignAngles.description: Reject fan-out provenance naming angles outside the gate's configured pool (default true).

mode.description: Angle dispatch mode: grouped batches related angles onto one reviewer each (default); per-angle bypasses the configured-groups table and emits one singleton unit per angle (the original full-scrutiny shape). per-angle is equivalent to maxAnglesPerGroup: 1 in dispatch unit size ONLY when no configured multi-angle group matches a resolved angle; otherwise per-angle bypasses configured groups while maxAnglesPerGroup: 1 honors them (matched first, never split).

groups.description: Static named angle groups consulted in grouped mode. An angle absent from every group joins the auto-chunked leftover pool (chunked into units of ≤maxAnglesPerGroup).

name.description: Group name; recorded as the shared reviewer's provenance `group` when this group dispatches.

angles.description: Angle names batched onto one reviewer when this group resolves.

maxAnglesPerGroup.description: Max angles per auto-chunked dispatch unit for leftover ungrouped angles (default 3, min 1). Configured groups are matched first and never split by this knob; mode: per-angle bypasses the table entirely (one singleton per angle).

maxConcurrent.description: Max dispatch units (groups) the conductor dispatches concurrently per wave (default 4, min 1). The wave plan is emitted by write-gate-context.mjs via scheduleFanoutWaves (scheduleParallelWaves).

fanout.description: Grouped vs per-angle fan-out dispatch policy + static grouping table (global, not per-gate).

gates.description: Gate review configuration: per-gate angle sets plus fan-out enforcement knobs.

stopAt.description: Checkpoints that require operator confirmation before the loop proceeds (default: ["merge"]).

humanMergeOnly.description: Merge stays a fixed human-only action: the agent never merges and any per-run merge authorization is ignored (fails closed).

autonomy.description: How far the loop proceeds without operator confirmation.

asyncStartMode.description: Whether the async start contract is required or merely allowed.

requireRetrospective.description: Require a retrospective checkpoint before a loop completes.

requireDraftFirst.description: Open pull requests as drafts and promote via the draft gate.

devModeDefault.description: Default new loops to dev mode.

baseBranch.description: Repo-level base/integration branch override (bare name, e.g. "main" or "spike/foo"). When set, worktree creation and PR targeting use it instead of the auto-detected default branch. Unset = auto-detect (origin/HEAD, else main/master).

workflow.description: Workflow posture: draft-first, retrospectives, dev mode, async start.

enabled.description: Opt small scoped changes into the lightweight dispatch path.

maxFiles.description: Light mode applies only when the change touches at most this many files.

maxLines.description: Light mode applies only when the change stays within this many lines.

maxCopilotRounds.description: Copilot round cap for light-dispatched PRs; composes as min(this, refinement.maxCopilotRounds).

issueless.description: Opt into issue-less PR-first dispatch at any change scope; gate dispatch still resolves inline vs full fan-out from scope on its own.

localImplementation.description: Local implementation dispatch (light mode for small scoped changes).

maxParallel.description: Maximum queue items worked in parallel.

maxAutoFiledIssues.description: Cap on auto-filed issues per run.

reDispatchMaxRetries.description: Retries when re-dispatching a failed queue item.

board.description: Deprecated: use tracker.board instead. GitHub Projects board identifier.

archiveOlderThanDays.description: Archive done board items older than this many days.

queue.description: Queue mode: parallelism, auto-filing caps, and Projects board opt-in.

plugin.description: Reserved: module specifier for an external tracker provider plugin (post-1.0, not implemented in this pass).

board.description: Tracker board identifier; supersedes the deprecated queue.board.

tracker.description: Tracker seam config: provider (default "github") and board. The github provider's logical-column->Status mapping is the existing queue.statusColumns; a future external provider defines its own.

internalPathPatterns.description: Regex whitelist for internal-only PR detection.

entries.description: Gitignored paths/globs provisioned into a fresh worktree.

mode.description: copy = fs.cp into the worktree (isolated, mutable); link = absolute symlink to the main checkout (shared, read-only).

worktree.description: Worktree provisioning: gitignored files/dirs copied or symlinked into fresh worktrees.

uiReview.description: UI-review route recipes: per-project run/boot, dev-login, driven flows, and caps.
